controls: Exact closed scope and immutable intent binding reject job redirection
Historical job replay cannot start a subsequent lifecycle attempt
Committed lifecycle start and held admission precede external ensure
Stable WorkerRef preserves external operation identity across Oban retries and coordinator lease epochs
Epoch loss before or during adapter effects cannot mutate through a stale token
Crash after external effect before journal reconciliation queries the same external operation
Cancellation and timeout retain occupancy until definite matching worker termination
Terminal historical evidence cannot release a subsequent reservation
Invalid adapter observations fail closed without release or unsupported retry
Only trusted deployment configuration selects an adapter; job arguments cannot select implementation
Test adapter and review fixtures are excluded from a production release
limitations: Independent reviewer does not start databases, services, providers or native runtimes
Source review alone is not real Oban execution evidence
Synthetic trusted adapters do not qualify provider authentication, customer-code isolation, external exactly-once effects or GA
Frozen catalog inspector and authority driver remain outside scope
